name: Performance
author: pelicaninstaller
description: Node-aware performance advisor: detects each server's workload (PaperMC, Forge/Fabric, Source engine, Python, Node.js, proxies) and recommends tuned startup flags, correct memory sizing (fixes unbounded JVM heaps), server.properties and user_jvm_args.txt optimizations with network tuning for slow or high-latency connections. Nothing is changed automatically - you review and apply.
